name: guardrails-approval
description: A human signs off before anything that can't be undone: publishing, killing protected processes, editing secrets or stale copies.

sensitiveFileGuard.title: sensitive-file-guard
sensitiveFileGuard.description: Refuse edits to credentials, keys, .env files, .git internals and Claude Code's own settings file.

publishGate.title: publish-gate
publishGate.description: Refuse making a GitHub repo public until you approve it with the one-time code the refusal shows.

publishGatePushes.title: publish-gate: pushes to public repos
publishGatePushes.description: Also hold git push to a public GitHub repo for your approval.

protectedProcess.title: protected-process
protectedProcess.description: Refuse killing or stopping the processes listed below outside their approved route.

protectedProcesses.title: protected-process: list
protectedProcesses.description: Semicolon-separated entries, each 'name' or 'name => approved route', e.g. 'postgres => systemctl restart postgresql; llama-server'.

messageRedact.title: message-redact
messageRedact.description: Replace credentials with [REDACTED] in messages sent to other agents or sessions.

messageTools.title: message-redact: message tools
messageTools.description: Comma-separated tool names that send messages; '*' is a wildcard. Empty uses SendMessage and any MCP send_message tool.

backupFileGuard.title: backup-file-guard
backupFileGuard.description: Refuse edits to backup copies (.bak, .orig, x~, 'Copy of x') and name the live file instead.

headroomCheck.title: headroom-check
headroomCheck.description: Hold a build or install when the drive it runs on is nearly full.

minFreeGB.title: headroom-check: free space floor (GB)
minFreeGB.description: Builds and installs below this much free space wait for your approval code.

staleCopyBand.title: stale-copy-band
staleCopyBand.description: Refuse edits inside a copy of a project marked as old, and point to the live copy.

staleCopyMarker.title: stale-copy-band: marker file
staleCopyMarker.description: Relative to the old copy's root. First line: the live copy's path. Following lines: why.

approvalMinutes.title: Approval window (minutes)
approvalMinutes.description: How long an approval code stays valid after you type it.

heartbeatDir.title: Heartbeat folder
heartbeatDir.description: Each pack writes <pack>.txt here at session start, read by /guardrails-status and the outside watchdog. '~' is your home folder. Empty turns it off.
